principles.item: Do not skip grounding/escalation for demo speed.
Always wire real LLM/embeddings/Qdrant/Docling/Postgres clients; live suites gated by RUN_LIVE_*.
Keep REST contracts stable after phase 1; version if breaking.
Russian user-facing copy OK; identifiers English.
All product work under server/ (rules, context, app, tests).
LangGraph for dialogue graph; do not adopt LangChain RetrievalQA as primary RAG.

goals.goal: Create server/ package layout (api, application, domain, adapters, config).
Wire FastAPI app with OpenAPI for all minimum endpoints.
Settings from env; .env.example consumed by pydantic-settings.
DI factories returning real Http*/Qdrant*/SqlAlchemy adapters.
Declare langgraph (+ optional langchain-core) in pyproject; dialogue graph module.

deliverables.item: server/pyproject.toml, app entrypoint, health check
Routers for appeals/messages/officer-reply/stats
Adapter protocols + HttpLLM, HttpEmbeddings, QdrantVectorStore, HttpDocling, EmailEscalation
Contract OpenAPI snapshot or schema tests
StateGraph under application/dialogue/

acceptance.check: uvicorn boots with configured env; adapters constructed from Settings
All documented REST paths exist and validate request/response models
langgraph importable; graph compiles with DI-injected nodes

goals.goal: PostgreSQL as system of record via SQLAlchemy 2 async + asyncpg.
DATABASE_URL from env; SqlAlchemyPersistence only.
Implement list/get/create appeal; append and list messages; history survives restart.
Appeal status transitions + audit events durable in Postgres.
Stats aggregates readable from DB (even if thin).

goals.goal: Implement LangGraph dialogue: clarify / grounded answer / escalate via retrieval ports.
Grounding policy: no answer without citations matching retrieved regulation chunks.
Escalation creates ticket + notifier + user-facing Russian notice.
Underspecified questions produce clarifying assistant messages.

deliverables.item: StateGraph nodes wired to grounding + quality_escalation + ports
Live/e2e behavior tests gated by RUN_LIVE_E2E

acceptance.check: Known corpus question → answer with citations
Ambiguous question → clarification, status clarifying
Unknown topic → escalate, no invented regulation text
Success criteria 1 and 2 demonstrable with live infra
Graph path auditable (node outcomes logged or asserted)

Blue/green collections and QDRANT_COLLECTION alias.
